assessment: This manuscript describes a new method of identifying disease-relevant risk genes from genome wide association studies by using a conditional gene-based method (named eDESE). The authors apply this new approach in an analysis of schizophrenia datasets, and identify meaningful biological processes and potential drug repurposing candidates. Thus, this new method could provide improved gene prioritization for fine-mapping and functional studies of specific diseases.
